sources.title: Pocket TTS - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Pocket TTS Overview Pocket TTS is Kyutai ’s 100M-parameter text-to-speech model, a Continuous Audio Language Model that runs faster than real time on CPU. A causal transformer emits one continuous audio latent per frame (12.5 Hz) through a one-step flow head, and an end-of-speech head decides when to stop.
